title: Achieving Asymptotic Near-Optimality Without $\delta$-Similarity
description:
arXiv:2609.04464v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Sampling-based motion planning algorithms are a popular class of trajectory planning algorithm due to their speed in complex, high-dimensional environments and ability to handle kinodynamic constraints, specifically through the use of forward dynamics propagation.
